messages:
Incident Bot: 🔔 INCIDENT: Elevated p99 latency observed on /v1/chat/completions (us-west-2) — alert fired across multiple models. Current p99 ~1.5s for last 5m. Links: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/chat-latency?orgId=1
Marta: saw it, paging oncall. I'm oncall now, looking at traces.
Alex: I'm seeing spikes correlated with long context sequences and heavy KV cache miss rate. Could be warmup/eviction after recent deploy to dedicated pools.
Ryan: quick check — no infra deploys in the last hour on the serving fleet. autoscaler did trigger a few scale-outs for GPU pool-3.
SRE-Bot: Pager run: @Marta, @Alex, @Ryan been paged. Incident severity set to SEV-2 due to customer degradation on low-throughput chat endpoints.
Marta: initial mitigation: disabling burst scaling for pool-3 for 10m to stabilize scheduling? Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Alex: I'd rather not disable autoscaling. Suggest route-level fallback: route chat.completions -> prefer smaller model variant when p95 > 500ms. We can push a temporary routing rule.
Sophie: I can stand up a temporary routing rule in the control plane. Doing it now, will monitor.
Sophie: applied route override: chat.completions -> model=mistral-small if p95 > 600ms for 2m. Watch dashboard.
Marta: good. Also we need to reduce alert noise — current p99 alert is too sensitive for chat.stream vs chat.completions. We should split alerts per route and per model.
Alex: agree. Currently infra/alerts/chat_latency.yaml has a global p99 700ms for all chat traffic. That causes noisy pages for heavy-context LLMs.
Ryan: propose short-term: raise global p99 to 1.2s for large models (>=32B) and create per-route p99 700ms for interactive chat routes. Also add a 5m suppression window after autoscaler events.
Marta: concrete steps:
1) Create PR to update alert rules (infra/alerts/chat_latency.yaml) with model and route overrides.
2) Add suppression rule keyed on autoscaler events (alias: autoscaler-scaleout) for 6m.
3) Bake in per-model baselines in Grafana panels and alert templates.
I'll own 1 and 2 for immediate mitigation.
Alex: here's a minimal alert snippet to use (apply as temporary change):
```
- alert: ChatCompletions_P99_PerRoute
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(reporter_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model)) > bool 0.7
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p99 latency high for {{ $labels.route }} (model={{ $labels.model }})"
```
Add a model-specific threshold map in templating.
Ryan: created PR draft: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/alerts/pulls/482 (WIP) — includes p99 overrides and an autoscaler suppression rule.
SRE-Bot: CI checks started for PR 482.
Marta: while PR runs, let's update the on-call playbook: change paging rule so that only p99 pages when at least two of these conditions are true: per-route p99 > threshold AND errors > 0.5%. This will cut noise from transient latency spikes.
Sophie: updated the playbook doc in the control plane (action: playbook/update-chat-latency). Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/oncall/playbooks/chat-latency
EngOps: can we also add a short-lived dashboard panel showing model-specific artifacts (KV cache hit rate, batch sizes, batch latency) next to p95/p99 so oncall can triage faster?
Alex: yes — adding panels now. Will include example queries and suggested remediation hints.
Marta: customer impact note: Customer A's production traffic saw ~8% reduction in success rate for streaming completions for 10m window — flagged CS. We should include this in the incident ticket.
Ryan: logging note — stack traces show many requests hitting sequence length > 8k which cause fallback decoder paths. We'll look at upstream prompt size enforcement.
SRE-Bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-3198. Assigned to Marta.
Marta: action items assigned:
- Marta: merge PR 482 after CI and small review (temp thresholds), create rollback plan.
- Alex: instrument per-model baseline metrics and add panel templates (ETA 1h).
- Sophie: monitor routing overrides and rollback if error rate increases.
- Ryan: review autoscaler logs and surface any unusual GC/driver errors (ETA 30m).
- EngOps: follow up with CS about Customer A impact and mitigation steps.
Marta: timeline: will keep this thread as the oncall handoff record. Handoff to @Ryan at 08:00 UTC. If anything urgent before then, page @Ryan directly.
Ryan: ack, will take handoff at 08:00. After merge, we should schedule a post-incident review focused on alert tuning — specifically: per-route baselining, model-aware thresholds, and a mechanism for temporary autoscaler suppression.
Sophie: noted — I'll create a dashboard snapshot and attach to the PIR.
Alex: long-term ask: consider switching p99 alerts to anomaly detection vs static thresholds for each model/route pair. That will reduce ops churn.
Marta: agreed. Add to PIR as recommended engineering work.
SRE-Bot: Incident SEV downgraded to SEV-3 at 1798765490 after routing override stabilized p99 below 800ms.
Marta: closing notes: PR 482 merged at 1798765560 (temporary rules). Monitoring shows p99 back to baseline for chat.completions. We'll keep the per-model exceptions for 24h then iterate. Postmortem owner: Alex.
Ryan: thanks team. I'll monitor during my shift and file follow-ups as needed. :thumbsup:
